cd /app && cat > prep.py <<'EOF'
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
import re

def clean(t):
    t = t.replace('\\n',' ').replace('\n',' ').replace('\r',' ').replace('\t',' ')
    t = t.lower()
    t = re.sub(r"([.!?,/'()\"])", r" \1 ", t)
    t = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t).strip()
    return t

for split,out in [('train','train.txt'),('test','test.txt')]:
    df = pq.read_table(f'data/{split}-00000-of-00001.parquet').to_pandas()
    with open(out,'w') as f:
        for lab,txt in zip(df['label'],df['text']):
            f.write(f"__label__{lab} {clean(txt)}\n")
    print(split, len(df))
EOF
